stem: What is the minimum duration of symptoms required to define constipation in children?
explanation: Two weeks is the minimum symptom duration used to define constipation in children.

optionExplanations.A: Incorrect because one week is shorter than the minimum duration used in the definition.
optionExplanations.B: Correct because constipation in children is defined by symptoms lasting more than two weeks.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because one month is longer than the minimum definition threshold given here.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because two months is well beyond the minimum duration required to define constipation.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because three months is longer than the minimum definition threshold used for constipation.
